master_predictions.statement_excerpt: 顷刻有三客至，内必杨姓者；郎君理应回东省取功名；贵地（山东）不日兵动，有攻城破邑之事，眷属宜迁他处避之；尊堂寿止八十有九；目今须防失脱，且贼去而复来。
key_assertions: 顷刻三客至、内有杨姓
其子应回山东取功名
山东不日兵动、攻城破邑，宜迁避
其母寿止89岁（不得度九十）
将失盗，且盗贼去而复来

outcome.description: 三客至、内有杨姓，果如言；王宅书房被盗，所盗为郎君之物，三日后贼复来尽盗父子衣物；冬月清兵入山东、攻城陷邑，一一如占；王米山迁居淮安新安镇，其母未度九十而终（89岁）。各应验点均独立载于原文。
outcome.source: 《大六壬占验指南》原文应验段；注解引《明史》证冬月清兵克蓟州、入山东陷州县

master_predictions.statement_excerpt: 巡方官必复，吏书缺未能如旧。铸印乘轩，主迁官转职、面君奏事；格合回还，去而复来、已废复兴；占二得一。
key_assertions: 巡按差必复设
吏书缺不能照旧（一复一不复，占二得一）

outcome.description: 未几，工科上疏题复巡按差，巡方官复设；吏书缺未复。原文以「以四课不全，故占二得一」收束，应验段独立。

master_predictions.statement_excerpt: We may well be in serious danger of a new pandemic at the 2020-2021 mark, at the lowest peak of the cyclical index of the 21st century, with the quintet of outer planets gathered over a hundred degrees, a conjunction Jupiter-Saturn-Pluto can more specifically, and even specifically, lend itself to the 'tissue' of this imbalance. Nevertheless, this configuration can also transfer its core of dissonances to the terrain of geophysical disasters, without ultimately sparing the international affairs scene.
key_assertions: A new pandemic is a serious danger specifically at the 2020–2021 mark
The trigger configuration is the Jupiter–Saturn–Pluto conjunction with the five outer planets gathered within ~100 degrees
Alternative manifestation in geophysical disasters / international affairs is allowed for in the same passage (hedge noted)

outcome.description: COVID-19 emerged in December 2019 and the WHO declared a pandemic on 11 March 2020; the pandemic ran through 2020–2021 and beyond.
outcome.source: WHO pandemic declaration of 11 March 2020 and the universal public record of the COVID-19 pandemic

provenance.work: L'Astrologue no.177 (2012), 'Aperçu sur les Pandémies'; text and translation as quoted in The Astrology Podcast episode 'Misconceptions About Mundane Astrology in the Media' (11 May 2020)

master: United Astrology Conference 2012 forecasting panel (panel of renowned astrologers; unanimous)

master_predictions.statement_excerpt: It's unanimous: A panel of renowned astrologers predicts President Obama will win re-election in November. ... This year's panelists used an array of different techniques to reach their predictions. One panelist inserted the candidates' birth information into winter solstice charts and directed the information to the swearing-in location, Washington, D.C. Another looked at planetary charts dating back to 1880. All chose Obama to win.
key_assertions: Unanimous panel pick: Obama wins re-election
Panel warned the Election-Day Mercury retrograde could lead to voting irregularities (secondary remark)

outcome.description: Barack Obama defeated Mitt Romney on 6 November 2012 (332 electoral votes to 206) and began a second term.
outcome.source: Official US election results / universal public record

provenance.work: Astrology News Service, 'Panel of Astrologers Predicts Obama Victory', May 2012 (New Orleans)
provenance.edition: Astrology News Service news report

master_predictions.statement_excerpt: Back in July 2015, on this website, you read an astrology prediction about a Brexit, or British exit from the European Union. ... What we lacked at the time was a referendum date, but we have it now – Britain will vote to leave the EU on 23rd June, 2016. That makes the prediction firmer. The 'Stay' vote is beating the 'Go' vote according to newspaper polls at 22nd February 2016 ... The horoscope on the day is very sure, though.
key_assertions: Britain will vote to leave the EU on 23 June 2016
Scotland is also on her way to independence status (sub-assertion: not fulfilled as of 2026)
Even a 'Stay' result would not be accepted and the independence push would continue (hedge noted)

outcome.description: On 23 June 2016 the UK voted Leave by 51.9% to 48.1%; the UK left the EU on 31 January 2020. Scotland has not become independent.
outcome.source: UK Electoral Commission official referendum result / public record

provenance.work: Jessica Adams, 'How Astrology Predicts a Brexit', jessicaadams.com, 22 February 2016 (referencing her 5 July 2015 'GOODBYE EU' post)
provenance.edition: Author's website (staging mirror read)

master_predictions.statement_excerpt: 'Who will win the 2019 elections?' ... Bejan Daruwalla, a well-known Indian astrology columnist, has a simple answer to this — 'Modi will steal the show.' ... 'This time the struggle will be more and the fight will be tougher. However, Modi will steal the show. ... I have seen, using seven different methods that Modi will win.'
key_assertions: Modi will win the 2019 election, though the fight will be tougher than in 2014
Rahul Gandhi is capable but Modi is 'always one step ahead'

outcome.description: The BJP won 303 seats and the NDA formed the government; Narendra Modi began a second term as Prime Minister on 30 May 2019.
outcome.source: Election Commission of India official results / public record
